source: Open Images V7 download page's V5 validation boxes and human image labels
selection: All eligible football-positive images plus three deterministic verified Ball(Object)-negative images per positive. Exclude any positive ball label from the negative pool.
overlap_exclusion: Exclude Flickr photo IDs in all COCO 2017 train and validation image records; reject unknown photo identities. This does not certify absence from every backbone pretraining dataset.
qualification: Require explicit per-image CC BY 2.0, known zero rotation and author identity. Exclude ball group/depiction images and ambiguous overlapping parent/subclass boxes. Merge exact identical boxes only.
split: SHA256 coreorigin-openimages-football-v1: plus normalized author profile URL; first eight hex digits modulo five equal zero is final_test, others development.
inference: No training or threshold tuning. YOLO11m keeps its existing 1920 input protocol; RF-DETR uses its published processor size. Both float32, confidence >=0.05, at most 300 detections; retain only sports ball by class name.
selection_metric: Development AP50, with no decline in precision or recall at confidence 0.05. Ties retain existing detector. Freeze choice before final-test metrics; no possession promotion from this component result alone.
